alex: quick sync — we need a coordinated version bump across repos for the hotfix window tomorrow. Cutoff 2025-05-15 10:00 PT. Who's owning cutover for each repo (API / runtime / console / SDKs)? Any blockers?

maria: I'm on API + SDK. I'm opening the API PR now — minor contract tweak (nullable field). Target api -> v1.7.0, sdk-js -> v4.1.0. I'll add changelog fragments.

jamal: runtime here — we need a kernel patch for perf. Prefer to stagger runtime after API to avoid cache churn. ETA for runtime PR: EOD today. target runtime -> v0.14.2.

ryan: console ok for v2.3.1, no breaking UI changes. I'll add the changelog entry and a single bump PR.

alex: rough stagger plan: 1) API + SDK, 2) Console, 3) Runtime. If CI is green at each stage we tag and propagate. Please add the [changelog] label to your PRs. Also include migration notes if any.

alex: versions (for quick copy):
```
api: v1.7.0
sdk-js: v4.1.0
console: v2.3.1
runtime: v0.14.2
```

maria: notes — API PR includes this snippet to opt in to the new field:
```json
{"response": {"new_field": null}}
```

jamal: small FYI, runtime bump will flip a kernel flag. Rollout steps are in the PR description. If any infra flake blocks us, we should hold runtime.

ryan: tagged docs and added console changelog. Will wait for API + SDK merge before cutting console tag.

deploy-bot: pre-cut CI status: 3 PRs queued (api, sdk-js, console). Tests running on all — est ~12m. Link: https://ci.internal/recent/1759994321

maria: pinging docs and support to prep release notes. If someone wants to coordinate canary checks, I can run smoke tests once API is stable.

alex: final reminder — please aim to merge by 9:30 PT to allow the 10:00 PT cutoff for canary verification. If you hit flakes, ping #eng-sre. :thumbsup:

ryan: I'm on call for tagging + small rollback plan if needed.

jamal: noted — will hold runtime tag until we confirm canary health.

alex: thanks everyone — post merge drop a short message here with tags so I can update the release tracker.
